breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The terminal velocity must be estimated by balancing weight minus buoyancy with aerodynamic drag,' which directly corrects the original flawed instruction to neglect drag. This aligns with the ground truth's approach of balancing weight minus buoyancy against aerodynamic drag to determine terminal velocity.
